scientific_integrity: The theorem concerns the lower central series of the canonical radical-unit Sylow subgroup over every finite field in odd defining characteristic. The argument is a direct computation of a Lie bracket table followed by the class-below-characteristic exponential correspondence; finite enumeration is corroborative, not a general proof. Priority outside inspected literature has not been certified.
scientific_limitations: No generalization to characteristic two or to dihedral groups of order twice a higher prime power is established.
Group terms are for 1+Jac(A), not for the entire unit group.
Equivalent presentations in unlocated older literature and an inaccessible full 1970 source remain material originality risks.
No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Alternating lower-central ranks of radical units in modular dihedral group algebras
